records.claim: Birth defects can happen in any pregnancy for different reasons. Out of all babies born each year, about 3 out of 100 (3%) will have a birth defect. We look at research studies to try to understand if an exposure, like docusate sodium, might increase the chance of birth defects in a pregnancy. When used as directed, docusate sodium is unlikely to increase the chance of birth defects above the background risk.
records.source_section: Does taking docusate sodium increase the chance of birth defects?
